what: The ”View all →” link plays one spin on hover — the text slides up −120% while fading and the same text rises from 120% below (.8s), the underline vanishes to the right and is redrawn from the left (.5s), and the arrow in the box exits left while a new arrow enters from the right (.8s, .15s later). Everything returns to the start position at .8s, when the next text has fully risen, so the late-starting new arrow is cut off there (for arrow buttons without text, it ends when the new arrow has fully entered)

options.ease: Curve of the form ”0.165,0.84,0.44,1”, which is the default (quart out)
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text to swap in (the whole element text if omitted). If there are several, they all rotate together — for when the number, title and description sit on one line
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Underline (optional). Empty span — the part draws it as a 1px line
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Arrow box (optional). One svg inside — the part makes one more set
options.out: Length (sec) of the dropping text (first wave) alone, default same as dur — knot .6
options.out-ease: Curve of the exiting text in the form ”0.333,0.667,0.667,1”, same as the default ease — the original "expo.inout"(lowercase so GSAP can’t read it and runs the default power1.out) so it is identical to power1.out at 0.333,0.667,0.667,1
options.look: solid: The rising text (second set) does not fade, it only slides up (knot)
options.rest: Resting position (%) of the rising text (second layer), same as the default shift — if farther, it jumps to shift the moment hover starts and rises (knot 150 → 105)
options.keep: 1 means that after turning it rests at the end spot (with the second set visible), and the next time you hover it spins again from the start — for when the original is GSAP fromTo and does not go back (knot). By default it returns to the start spot after a full turn
options.focus: When off, keyboard focus or press (focusin) won’t trigger the spin, it only spins on hover — as when the original hooked only mouseenter. By default it spins on focus too

use: View All

from.where: shared.css .lh-swap (common-view-all-link — header band · footer · ‹View All› · culture list rows · job card arrows)
